## Installation

Two separate packages, one for each half of the day. Both need **Python 3.11 or newer**.

**For downloading papers** (morning) —
[tmsr-doi-downloader](https://pypi.org/project/tmsr-doi-downloader/), from the eScience
Center:

```bash
pip install tmsr-doi-downloader
```

**For the causal map** (afternoon) —
[theoryminer](https://pypi.org/project/theoryminer/):

```bash
pip install theoryminer
```

In a notebook or Colab, put a `%` in front: `%pip install theoryminer`.

### Run this once before you arrive

So the models are cached on your machine, not downloaded on the conference network:

```python
from theoryminer import causenet
causenet(["Increased workload leads to higher levels of burnout."])
```

### One key to set

The downloader's Unpaywall source needs an email address, in a `.env` file in your working
directory:

```
UNPAYWALL_EMAIL=your.email@example.com
```

No GPU needed. In Colab, Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU is faster and free.
